name: Intercom
one_liner: Intercom offers a REST API with OAuth2 or Bearer token authentication, enabling developers to manage contacts, conversations, articles, and more.
auth_notes: Use the Authorization: Bearer <token> header to authenticate API requests.
access_notes: Create an app in the Developer Hub to obtain an access token.

extras.rate_limits: 10,000 API calls per minute for each app and 25,000 API calls per minute per workspace.

evidence.snippet: You can create a new app for your production workspace and get the access token for the app by going to https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/{your-workspace-id}/developer-hub/
Learn how to use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable AI agents to securely access and interact with your Intercom data whenever helpful.
